releaseNotes:
• Strict Female-Only Filtering: Only blurs exposed body parts (breasts, cleavage/swimwear, bare midriff, exposed thighs/legs). Fully-clothed men (shirts, polos) and clothed women are never blurred.
• Strict Male-Only Filtering: Only blurs males who are shirtless or wearing shorts. Fully-clothed men in shirts/polos/jackets are never blurred.
• Media Container Boundary Containment: Full-body and targeted blur boxes are strictly confined within image and video cards, never overflowing onto search UI, buttons ('Visit', 'Save'), or adjacent images.
• Full-Body Shielding: Accurately shields from neck down to feet or container boundary while preserving face.
• Face Blurring Control: Blurs face from jaw to forehead when enabled; guarantees complete facial clarity and protection when disabled.
• Pure Solid Black Overlay: Eliminated hollow ghost stroke frames around chins.
• Signed Release: Digitally signed package resolving 'App not installed' error.
